questions.q: ___ heavy snow, all flights were cancelled.
questions.why: Причина + іменник — *Owing to heavy snow*. *Owing* без *to* — неповне; *Because* + іменник — бракує *of*; *Thanks* без *to* — неповне.

questions.q: I'm writing ___ your advertisement in Monday's newspaper.
questions.why: «Щодо» — *with regard to* (або *regarding*). *in regard of*, *regarding to*, *with regards of* — неправильні вирази.

questions.q: She accepted the award ___ her whole team.
questions.why: «Від імені» — *on behalf of*. *in behalf to*, *on the behalf*, *behalf of* — неправильні вирази.

questions.q: They bought the house with a view to ___ it.
questions.why: *with a view to* + *-ing*, бо *to* — частина прийменника. *renovate*, *renovated*, *have renovated* — неграматично.

questions.q: ___ price, this is the best phone on the market.
questions.why: «З погляду» — *In terms of*. *In term of*, *By terms of*, *On terms* — неправильні форми.

questions.q: The prize is open to everyone, ___ age.
questions.why: «Незалежно від» — *regardless of*. Без *of* — неповне; *regarding of* і *in regardless of* — неграматично.
«За» — *in favour of*. *in favour to*, *on favour of*, *for favour of* — неправильні вирази.

questions.q: The data was collected ___ an online survey.
questions.why: «За допомогою» — *by means of*. *by mean of*, *with means of*, *by the mean* — неправильні форми.

questions.q: The decision was made ___ the company's rules.
questions.why: «Відповідно до» — *in accordance with*. *in accordance to*, *according with*, *in accord of* — неправильні вирази (правильно ще *according to*).

questions.q: ___ the recent complaints, we are reviewing our service.
questions.why: «Зважаючи на» — *In view of*. *In the view*, *On view of*, *By view of* — неправильні вирази.

questions.q: ___ English and French, she speaks fluent Arabic.
questions.why: «На додачу до» + іменник — *In addition to*. *In addition* без *to* — окремий прислівник «крім того»; *Addition to* і *As addition to* — неграматично.

questions.q: The flight was cancelled ___ the pilots' strike.
questions.why: «Через» — *on account of*. Без *of* — неповне; *in account of* і *by account of* — неправильні форми.

questions.q: He apologised and offered to pay, by ___ of compensation.
Please stay calm, for the ___ of the children.
In addition to ___ (work) full-time, she studies at night.
I like natural fabrics, as ___ to synthetic ones.

answer: Owing to the strike the trains were cancelled
Owing to the strike, the trains were cancelled
She is speaking on behalf of the whole team
